title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 011 ]

blocks.text: The Crane could help us in many ways in the future. It could help make a giant
telescope. We could then see seven times further into space. It could fly into space and
back again and again. It could also help build a solar power station in space. This would
give it extra power for longer flights. Who knows what the future will bring? Perhaps it will
one day take people for sightseeing trips around the moon.

readingSentences.english: The Crane could help us in many ways in the future.
readingSentences.korean: 크레인은 앞으로 여러 면에서 우리를 도울 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: It could help make a giant telescope.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 거대한 망원 경을 만드는 것을 도와 줄 수 있을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: We could then see seven times further into space.
readingSentences.korean: 그러면 우리는 7배나 더 멀리 우주를 볼 수 있게 된다.

readingSentences.english: It could fly into space and back again and again.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 우주로 날아가서 다시 돌아오고 다시 간다.

readingSentences.english: It could also help build a solar power station in space.
readingSentences.korean: 또한 그것은 우주에 태양 발전소를 건설할 수 있게 해 준다.

readingSentences.english: This would give it extra power for longer flights.
readingSentences.korean: 이것은 장시간의 비행을 위해 여분의 전력을 그것에 공급할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Who knows what the future will bring?
readingSentences.korean: 미래에 무슨 일이 생길지 누가 알겠는가?

readingSentences.english: Perhaps it will one day take people for sightseeing trips around the moon.
readingSentences.korean: 아마도 언젠가 그것은 달로 관광을 가려는 사람들을 실어 나를 것이다.
